title: Your bed
goals: Sleep in the free bed beside {mate}'s.
starting_code: # We share a dormitory! Walk to the free bed beside mine and sleep.
hints: First, walk up to enter our dormitory through the arch on the right.
Take a few steps right to stand beside the free bed.
Finally, use the `sleep` method to lie down and rest.
intro: Hello! We are sharing a dormitory this year. You must be tired after the journey! The free bed is the one right beside mine. Come on in, lie down and get some sleep.
outro: Good morning! Let us go to the library and find you a school wand of your own.
learned: Now you know that an action may need the right place, and that a program must walk there first.
